advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Scope the --timeout / --timeout-method=thread assertion to each matched pytest invocation line rather than the whole run body, so a second unguarded invocation in a multi-command block cannot pass vacuously.
evidence: _all_workflow_pytest_steps returns one tuple per (file, step, body), so a multi-invocation run block is checked as a single unit: the body-substring assertion cannot distinguish a guarded invocation from an unguarded sibling in the same block.

_optionality.yml:110-119 shows a single step whose body contains both a pip line and a `python -m pytest` invocation — a body-scoped substring check attributes any one `--timeout=` to the whole block.
advisory.finding: test_every_ci_pytest_lane_has_a_per_test_hang_guard asserts `--timeout=` / `--timeout-method=thread` are present anywhere in the step's run body, not on the same command as the pytest invocation. A run block with multiple pytest invocations (e.g. _optionality.yml's step, which chains pip install + python -c + python -m pytest) that guarded only one command would pass vacuously — the second invocation could go unguarded and the assertion would still hold.
scenarios: A future edit adds a second pytest invocation to an existing multi-command run block and guards only the first; the deadlock guard is missing on the second but the test stays green.
advisory.suggested_fix: Split the run body on the _PYTEST_INVOCATION match positions (or iterate the individual shell lines that match the invocation regex) and assert the two flags appear on the same logical command as each pytest invocation, not merely somewhere in the body.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm `--durations=25` on the jira-dc-harness lane is authorized by the hang-guard ticket, or split it into its own ticket — AC10 limits the change to the added timeout flags.
evidence: .github/workflows/external-integration.yml:593 — comment: "--durations=25 is added with it: no lane here has ever printed per-test durations, so the tail behind that mean is unmeasured and a future re-calibration would otherwise be guesswork."
AC10: 'no lane's selection, markers, or behavior changes beyond the added flags.' — the added flags being the `--timeout`/`--timeout-method=thread` pair enumerated in AC1-AC7
advisory.finding: The jira-dc-harness pytest step adds `--durations=25`, a diagnostic-output flag that is neither of the two hang-guard flags (`--timeout=`/`--timeout-method=thread`) the ticket authorizes. Its own comment frames it as gathering per-test duration data for a FUTURE budget re-calibration — a separate concern from the per-test hang guard.
advisory.suggested_fix: Drop `--durations=25` from this hang-guard change and land it under its own ticket covering the future budget re-calibration it serves.
